package domain

import "testing"

func TestNormalizeComposeConfigTreatsJSONNullAsAbsent(t *testing.T) {
	for _, raw := range [][]byte{nil, []byte(""), []byte("  null\n")} {
		if got := NormalizeComposeConfig(raw); got != nil {
			t.Fatalf("expected %q to normalize to nil, got %q", raw, got)
		}
		if HasComposeConfig(raw) {
			t.Fatalf("expected %q not to be a compose config", raw)
		}
	}

	raw := []byte(`{"services":{"app":{"image":"node:20-alpine"}}}`)
	if got := NormalizeComposeConfig(raw); string(got) != string(raw) {
		t.Fatalf("expected compose config to remain unchanged, got %s", got)
	}
	if !HasComposeConfig(raw) {
		t.Fatal("expected object payload to be a compose config")
	}
}
